note: Every entry is keyed to one rule, one exact file path, exact matched texts with maximum counts, and a written reason that records what the matched text is in context. No directory-wide, wildcard or whole-rule exclusions are accepted (validateExceptions enforces this). Third-party entries describe files that the existing packager ships inside app.asar; Z8.1 did not change that. Chunk-hashed first-party asset names (IntlProvider-*.js) change with content, so a new hash surfaces as a new unexplained hit that must be reviewed again.
